fields.finding: Round-1 Conflict (non-resident 20%-of-gross employees with a depurated base in column U) stands and stays a query (decision 8). The round-2 G2N carries NO depurated base column (WT columns only, plus social-security bases 64990-64996 and an unlabelled client column '64993 formula' that matches no Base of Withholding column), so casilla 77 can still only be evidenced from the round-1 Base of Withholding (column U, 6,263,719,152) and for one run only. NEW FACTUAL CORRECTION to the Query to RA text (T22): it says 'Master Data holds 9 employees with Tax Procedure 1 = 3, 7 of them in the Sep-2026 Base of Withholding'. Re-checked: ALL 9 Procedure-3 employees are in the Base of Withholding and in the G2N (the Base of Withholding and G2N hold the same 261 IDs). 7 carry % Retention 0.2 and are withheld at exactly 20% of Income Total G; the other 2 carry % Retention 0 and are withheld at about 15.9% and 34.3% of Income Total, i.e. not on the art. 408 pattern. So 'Tax Procedure 3' alone does not identify the 20%-of-gross population. The round-1 verifier's statement that 2 Procedure-3 employees were absent from the Base of Withholding is not reproduced by the data. NEW (client-specific): below the G2N GRAND TOTAL the client lists 6 employee IDs in column U (rows 279-284) without a label: 5 are Procedure-3 employees (4 of the 20% group and 1 of the 2 others) and 1 is a Procedure-1 employee withheld at 39.5% of gross; the purpose of the list is not stated.

fields.finding: (1) CLAIM VERIFIED - the round-2 'Monthly' G2N is NOT a combination of all September runs. Title block: Pay Group(s) 'CO - Monthly', Payroll id REF-P201-090, generation date 2026-09-16, headcount 261 - identical to the round-1 Vertical G2N. Same 261 employee IDs; 120 wage-type columns x 261 employees = 31,320 cells; all 6,746 non-zero employee x WT values equal the round-1 vertical amounts in absolute value, with no value present in one file and absent in the other (only the sign convention differs: deductions are positive in the horizontal layout, negative in the vertical one). WT 2552 = 1,399,199,389 and WT 21330 = 69,301,209 in both; 2552 + 21330 = 1,468,500,598 = round-1 Base of Withholding GRAND TOTAL of column V, and per employee 2552 + 21330 = V for 261 of 261 (the 6 WT 21330 employees have 2552 = 0). The Base of Withholding title shows Payroll id REF-P201-065 for the same 261 IDs, confirming the existing instruction not to use 'Payroll id' as the run key. (2) THIRD SOURCE - Nomina Electronica: in Monthly_fixed every ENC block's REC worker code (column R) equals the ENC worker code and a G2N Employee ID (261/261); SVA position 2 (RetencionFuente, NIE177) equals 2552 + 21330 for 261 of 261 employees (230 non-zero; of the 31 zero-withholding employees 27 have no SVA segment and 4 have an SVA segment with position 2 empty); total 1,468,500,598. Match rate 100%: G2N, Base of Withholding column V and NE RetencionFuente agree employee by employee for this pay group. (3) WHAT THE FILE DOES NOT PROVE: the 'all runs of the month' total. For the 261 CO - Monthly employees the round-1 Accumulated Report Sep-2026 WT 2552 equals the G2N for 261 of 261, so for this pay group the run seems to hold the whole month's 2552; the gap is in OTHER populations: 97 IDs outside CO - Monthly with 144,635,503 of WT 2552 (93 of them paid WT 61100 'Weekly advance' and 62838 'Exceptional Advance'; 2 paid WT 62203 'Reconciliations PMI additional payment- 541Q'; 1 paid WT 62115 'Retirement Allowance'), the retirees' withholding on WT 21140 (5,145,376), and 2 CO - Monthly employees paid WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance' (15,505,430) outside REF-P201-090. The evidenced September withholding on work and retiree income is therefore at least 1,618,281,477 (2552 1,543,834,892 + 21330 69,301,209 + 21140 5,145,376) against 1,468,500,598 in the single run. (4) NEW for the Field Explanation: the client's NE Mapping sends to RetencionFuente (SVA_2) not only 2552 and 21330 but also 21114 'Theoretical income Tax-5011', 21619 'Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035', 21129, 25832, 25833, 25834 and the retiree/pensioner WTs 21140 'Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799' and 21155 'Income Tax Pensioner'. The draft says casilla 93 must reconcile to the sum of NIE177; with the client's mapping that holds only if retiree withholding is also in casilla 93, or if the reconciliation is against casillas 93 + 94. The draft does not say this, and the DECISION PENDING item (b) does not list 21114 / 21619. (5) No column for 21129, 25832, 25833, 25834, 21140 or 21155 exists in the round-2 G2N (none was paid in this run).
fields.proposed_explanation: See change map M23 (adds the NE RetencionFuente match, the pay-group scope, theoretical WTs 21114/21619 in item (b), and the NIE177 reconciliation caveat for retiree WTs 21140/21155).
